title: Module 1: Java Fundamentals & Control Flow
description: Learn the JVM, primitive types, control flow, loops, and basic array processing.

lessons.title: JVM, JRE, JDK, Literals, Variables, Loops & Arrays

exercises.title: JVM Components
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Which component is strictly responsible for executing the compiled Java bytecode?

exercises.title: Sum of Evens
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Write a function `sumEvens` that takes an array of integers and returns the sum of all even numbers.
hints: Use a `for` loop to iterate through the array.
Use the modulo operator `%` to check if a number is even.
Keep a running total in an `int` variable.

exercises.title: Debug: Array Reversal
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Fix the loop condition so it successfully prints the array backwards without crashing.
hints: If an array has size 3, the highest index is 2.
